task.summary: Add reproducible synthetic text-safety benchmark evidence and a runtime CycloneDX SBOM.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a versioned bilingual synthetic benchmark covering safe and unsafe examples for every current text-safety rule.
Fail the automated benchmark when the observed status or exact rule-code set differs from the expected result.
Generate deterministic machine-readable JSON and human-readable Markdown reports without external model or service calls.
Generate a runtime-only CycloneDX 1.6 JSON SBOM and upload the reports and SBOM as CI artifacts.
Document reproduction steps and explicit synthetic-only, non-clinical-validity limitations in English and Chinese.
Pass the full build, receipt verifier, supply-chain checks, and independent AI review.

scope.description: Synthetic bilingual benchmark dataset and regression runner, deterministic evidence reports, CycloneDX SBOM generation, CI artifact upload, source metadata, and bilingual documentation.

tests.command: JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 24) ./mvnw -Dtest=SyntheticSafetyBenchmarkTest test; repeat and compare SHA-256 for both reports
jq validate CycloneDX 1.6 metadata, required component scopes, excluded test dependencies, and project VCS URL
git ls-remote actions/upload-artifact refs/tags/v7.0.1 and verify pinned workflow SHA
